questions.question: Which British Act designated the Governor of Bengal as the 'Governor-General of Bengal' and established the Supreme Court at Calcutta?
questions.explanation: The Regulating Act of 1773 created the office of Governor-General of Bengal (Lord Warren Hastings) and established the Supreme Court at Calcutta in 1774 with Sir Elijah Impey as Chief Justice.

questions.question: Who was the first person to propose the idea of a Constituent Assembly for India in 1934?
questions.explanation: M.N. Roy, a pioneer of the communist movement in India, first put forward the idea of a Constituent Assembly in 1934. The Indian National Congress officially demanded it in 1935.

questions.question: The historic 'Objectives Resolution', which formed the basis of the Preamble, was introduced in the Constituent Assembly on December 13, 1946 by whom?
questions.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru moved the historic Objectives Resolution on December 13, 1946. It was unanimously adopted by the Assembly on January 22, 1947, and its modified version forms the Preamble.

questions.question: Which constitutional amendment added the words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976 amended the Preamble for the first and only time, adding three words: Socialist, Secular, and Integrity.

questions.question: The Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly was appointed on August 29, 1947 under the chairmanship of:
questions.explanation: The Drafting Committee, consisting of 7 members, was set up on August 29, 1947 under the chairmanship of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. B.N. Rau was the Constitutional Advisor.
